title: Scoring run summary (run.json)
description: Written once per scoring run, next to scores.csv. Store it with the run: it says which model produced the scores, so a dashboard can show and filter by it.

git_commit.description: Commit the model was trained at.

feature_schema_hash.description: Changes whenever the model's inputs change.

uses_payment_type.description: Should be false for any production model (ADR-007).

threshold.description: Score at or above which `alert` is true.
